name: Assoc Prof Glen Hosking
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: I am a Clinical Psychologist who works with adults, children, couples and adolescents. I have over 20 years experience working with clients presenting with a range of problems, including depression, anxiety, grief and loss, relationship problems, adjustment difficulties, sexuality, addictions (including problem gambling) and more.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual difficulties, Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Sexual abuse

name: Dr Mike Van Dijkhuizen
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: I specialise in depression, anxiety, addiction, trauma, anger, relationships, and male psychosexual and sexuality issues, with a focus on LGBTQ+ clients using an identity-affirming approach. I only work by telehealth from Melbourne. I completed my doctorate in clinical psychology at University College London in 2003, with training in cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT), schema therapy, and dialectical behavioural therapy (DBT). I integrate CBT, schema therapy, DBT, ACT, and supportive counselling according to your needs. Earlier in my career I worked in social work, HIV/AIDS and sexual health counselling, and as a clinical psychologist in mental health, forensics and university settings in the UK, New Zealand, and Australia.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual difficulties, Schema Therapy

name: Monique Cadariu
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Monique is an empathetic, non-judgmental clinician who offers collaborative, compassionate, evidence-based therapy. Her trauma-informed approach centres on building a trusting therapeutic relationship where clients feel safe to explore challenges, and develop self-understanding and work towards meaningful change. Monique works with adults, supporting clients experiencing anxiety, depression, Autism, ADHD, relationship/interpersonal challenges, workplace or family conflict, stress, overwhelm, burnout, trauma, attachment concerns, low self-esteem and body image difficulties.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)
